newsitem.title: USA: Queen Sand buys gas, oil production.
newsitem.headline: Queen Sand buys gas, oil production.

text.p: DALLAS, Dec 16 (Reuter) Queen Sand Resources Inc said on Monday it signed a letter of intent to buy more oil and gas production for about $5.3 million and 1.1 million shares of its common stock.
The company said it bought a group of producing and developmental properties in Texas, Louisiana and Mississippi with estimated total proved reserves of 2.07 million barrels of oil per day.
